OsherMonitor.sol
 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 Deployed on: Celo Mainnet (chainId 42220)
 What it does:
   1. Called by orchestrator.js BEFORE executing any bridge transfer.
   2. Collects a basis-point service fee from the transfer amount.
   3. Emits a structured event for every transaction (off-chain indexing).
   4. Owner can update fee rate and withdraw collected fees.
 Fee model:
   - Fee is taken in the ERC-20 token being transferred (USDC/USDT/USDm/CELO).
   - feeBps = 50 by default = 0.5% (matches SERVICE_FEE_PERCENT in keys.js).
   - Max fee cap: 500 bps = 5% (hard-coded safety ceiling).
 Ownership:
   - Single owner at deploy time.
   - transferOwnership() available for future multisig migration.
 Upgradeability:
   - Intentionally NOT upgradeable (immutable logic, per your requirement).
   - Deploy a new contract and call setSuccessor() to migrate gracefully.
 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Emitted on every bridge transfer routed through Osher AI.
 Off-chain indexers (The Graph, custom listener) subscribe to this.
Emitted on every on-chain swap (USDm → USDC etc. via Mento)
